plainText:
Volume 20: The Third Journey is the twentieth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the sixth of eight volumes in the . Authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
Legendary Pokémon Kyogre and Groudon are unleashed, and the world descends into chaos! Ruby and Sapphire head down to Seafl oor Cavern to try and stop them. To make matters worse, Archie and Maxie, the leaders of evil Team Aqua and equally evil Team Magma, are controlling Kyogre and Groudon with the Blue Orb and the Red Orb. Or are the Legendary Pokémon controlling them...?!

Meanwhile, has Wally built up his strength enough to train with Ruby’s father, Gym Leader Norman?

==Major events==
 
Professor Birch loses Treecko and the Pokédex he was going to give to the he was supposed to meet.
finds the and the Pokédex in Pacifidlog Town.
Norman takes Wally to the Sky Pillar. Wally needs to climb to the tower's top.
Archie receives the Blue Orb and is able to control . He abandons in the Submarine Explorer 1.
and reach the Seafloor Cavern.
Courtney invades the Mossdeep Space Center.
The Gym Leaders fight the Team Aqua and Team Magma Admins.
The orbs take over Maxie and Archie's minds.
Kyogre, , Maxie, and Archie make their way to Sootopolis City. Maxie and Archie drag Ruby and Sapphire with them.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
No Pokémon are caught in this volume.

===Evolutions===
No Pokémon evolve in this volume.

==Gym battles==
Sapphire doesn't challenge any Gyms.

==Pokémon Contests==
Ruby doesn't participate in any Pokémon Contests.

==Trivia==
This is the first volume of any Pokémon manga to be released under VIZ Media's imprint Perfect Square. Previously, all of their volumes were released under the VIZ Kids imprint.
